## Progress

- Merged [PR #13](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/13): PR pipeline (dotnet build/test incl. Testcontainers, vulnerable NuGet check, web lint/build/test, pnpm audit, synthetic-ID check, gitleaks), Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, PR template
- Repo public: branch protection on main (checks dotnet, web, secrets required), GitHub secret scanning + push protection, CodeQL default setup, Dependabot security updates enabled
- Found and fixed on the way: tinypool critical advisories (vitest 3 → 5), a race in the telemetry test

## Description

Create .github/workflows/pr.yml running on every pull request: dotnet build with analyzers as errors, dotnet test (unit + Testcontainers integration), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit, vitest, CodeQL (C# + TypeScript), dependency review, secret scanning with push protection, Dependabot for NuGet/npm/GitHub Actions. Protect main: PR required, status checks required, linear history, no force push, signed tags for releases. Add CODEOWNERS and a PR template with the X1–X8 checklist.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A PR that fails build, tests, lint, type-check, CodeQL or secret scanning cannot be merged into main.
- [ ] **AC2.** Direct pushes and force pushes to main are rejected.
- [ ] **AC3.** Dependabot opens update PRs for NuGet, npm and Actions weekly.
- [ ] **AC4.** The PR template contains the X1–X8 Definition-of-Done checklist and a "synthetic data only" confirmation.
- [ ] **AC5.** Pipeline duration for the skeleton is under 10 minutes.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
